They want to calculate the cost from the first airport in the available list to the last airport in the same list, on the last day of October 2024, business class. Provide estimated total payable amount.

We need to get the list of all airports. Then pick first and last. Then get flight cost. Then we need to compute total payable amount. But we also need to consider that they want to arrange a flight on booking id 1234. That implies we might need to book a flight? Or just compute cost? The user says "I need to arrange a flight on booking id 1234 as soon as possible, and want to check different options." So maybe we need to book a flight? But they didn't specify details like card id. We can ask for card id? But the instruction says we should not ask clarifying questions. We need to proceed with best guess. We can assume they have a default card? We could try to get all credit cards. Then pick first card id. Then book flight. Then compute cost. Then compute total payable amount. But we don't know insurance. We can skip insurance. So we need to:

1. Get all credit cards. (get_all_credit_cards)
2. Get flight cost. (get_flight_cost)

We can't do that. So we cannot book flight. But we can compute cost. We can get flight cost. But we need to provide estimated total payable amount. That includes cost plus maybe taxes? But we don't have tax info. We can just provide cost. So we can call get_flight_cost. But we need travel_from, travel_to, travel_date, travel_class. We need to get list of airports. So call list_all_airports. Then pick first and last. Then call get_flight_cost. Then provide cost. That is the best we can do.

Thus we need to call list_all_airports. Then call get_flight_cost. Let's do that.
